heading: Preservation or historic preservation
lead: In this division, the term “preservation” or “historic preservation” includes—

tree.text: identification, evaluation, recordation, documentation, curation, acquisition, protection, management, rehabilitation, restoration, stabilization, maintenance, research, interpretation, and conservation;
education and training regarding the foregoing activities; or
any combination of the foregoing activities.
